lastCompletedStory.title: Derive every surviving wait budget from instrumented measurement and prove five consecutive green suites

nextStoryContext: US-002 was the only remaining non-operator story in this PRD (CAM-446), scoped to test/integration/orch-recycle-watch.test.ts only (per the story's notes, no change to test/helpers/wait-for-condition.ts: a local-to-the-file wrapper was the safer default since that helper backs 83 other call sites). All 5 waits in the file now funnel through a single local `waitForConditionMeasured` wrapper (the file's ONLY literal call site of the shared `waitForCondition` helper), which records the REAL elapsed time at the moment each predicate flips true (never the timeout value) and appends one JSON record per wait to the CAM_WAIT_TIMINGS-named JSONL artifact when that env var is set. `waitForWatcher` now delegates to `waitForConditionMeasured` for its diagnostic-on-failure behavior. A `MeasuredWaitOptions` type makes `intervalMs` required (not optional) at the type level, so every wait structurally declares its own poll interval. Budgets are unchanged in value from before (10_000/5_000/5_000/12_000/10_000ms) but are now justified in the header comment by real measurements: three consecutive full-suite (`bun test`, 6017 tests) green runs on 2026-08-05, worst observed elapsedMs per wait plus the resulting margin factor, explicitly NOT derived from the old right-censored 12209/12151/12183/12188ms timeout failures (CAM-433/CAM-446 history). Verified: bun run typecheck clean; all 9 AC oracles (including the file-scoped grep asserts and the 5x-consecutive-full-suite-green named-command oracle, ~78s per run) pass; bun run check:all fully green (12/12 gates). This PRD (CAM-446) has no more non-operator stories; the sidecar's next action after this is review, not another implement cycle.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Confirmed fs.appendFileSync(path, data, options) defaults to flag 'a' (creates the file if absent, appends if present) and encoding 'utf8'. Implementation calls appendFileSync(WAIT_TIMINGS_PATH, jsonLine, 'utf8') per wait, matching this contract exactly (accumulates one JSONL record per wait across a whole suite run).
